title: A compliance probe prints the diff of the live hooks against the clone
why: Degen ledger D24: live ~/.claude settings hooks drift from the clone and no check shows it.
source: retrospective 21:38 CST Nov 12; plans/degen-report-2026-11-12.md (restart-plan 4b915b4d), row D24
note: Add a probe to lint/compliance_probes.py that prints the diff of the live ~/.claude settings hooks against the clone. It skips hooks.SessionStart, which a cloud install rewrites (install.sh:1019). Shares a root with session-start-pin-skip-log and cloud-hooks-stale-copy.
